channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula promulga acordo Mercosul-UE e diz que texto é reação dos blocos a Trump
item.description: President Lula has promulgated the Mercosul-European Union agreement, describing it as a coordinated response by the blocs to the unilateral policies of the U.S. government under Donald Trump. He emphasized that the deal strengthens trade and political cooperation between the regions, reduces external dependencies, and expands opportunities for Brazilian exports, particularly in agribusiness and industry.

item.title: Haddad diz que tem orgulho de ter taxado os super-ricos
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo from the Workers' Party (PT), said he is proud to have been the finance minister who taxed the super-rich. He emphasized that previously, only workers paid income tax, while billionaires, betting companies, and banks were exempt or paid little. Haddad believes most Brazilians support fiscal justice, where the top of the pyramid pays its fair share.

item.title: Lula assina Acordo Mercosul-UE
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed the promulgation of the Mercosul-European Union Agreement, which will take effect in Brazil on May 1, 2026. He described the deal, reached after 26 years of negotiations, as a response to U.S. unilateralism and a reinforcement of multilateralism, featuring gradual tariff eliminations and quotas for sensitive goods like beef and ethanol. Lula also signed free trade agreements with Singapore and the EFTA bloc.

item.title: Senado aprova cadastro de condenados por violência contra mulher
item.description: The Senate approved a bill to create the National Registry of Persons Convicted of Violence Against Women (CNVM), containing data on individuals definitively convicted of femicide, rape, harassment, bodily injury, stalking, and psychological violence. The bill now awaits presidential sanction and will be managed by the federal government, with information shared among federal, state, and District Federal public security agencies. The initiative aims to deter potential offenders and provide victims with greater sense of security.

item.title: Saiba onde serão os atos do 1º de Maio pelo Brasil
item.description: Trade union centrals are calling for decentralized acts on Workers' Day, May 1st, 2026, with a central focus on the struggle to reduce the workday (ending the 6X1 shift) without salary reduction, alongside agendas such as combating femicide, confronting precarization, strengthening collective bargaining, and regulating app-based work. Events will take place in multiple Brazilian cities, with specific times and locations disclosed for each locality.

item.title: PF devolve credencial a agente dos EUA após aplicar o princípio da reciprocidade
item.description: The Federal Police returned the work credentials of a U.S. government employee based in Brasília after withdrawing them last week under the principle of reciprocity, in response to the Trump administration’s order for the departure of Brazilian delegate Marcelo Ivo de Carvalho, who was involved in the operation that led to the detention of Alexandre Ramagem. A second U.S. agent, Michael Myers, had already left Brazil on Wednesday under the same measure. The PF stated the return of credentials is pending clarification from the U.S. government regarding its actions against the Brazilian agent.

item.title: Lula diz que Acordo Mercosul-UE foi feito “a ferro, suor e sangue”
item.description: President Lula promulgated the Mercosul-EU Agreement, which takes effect on May 1, 2026 after 26 years of negotiations, describing it as achieved 'by iron, sweat and blood'. The deal will gradually eliminate tariffs on 91% of EU goods by Mercosul and 95% of Mercosul goods by the EU, with quotas for sensitive products such as beef and ethanol, and includes provisions for SMEs and customs facilitation.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Entrevista com Sergio Moro e a nova pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: In the Papo Antagonista program, Senator Sergio Moro, pré-candidate for governor of Paraná, was interviewed about his positions and campaign. The discussion also covered the new AtlasIntel poll, which shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in a hypothetical second round of the 2026 presidential election. The content underscores the relevance of these figures in Brazil’s current political landscape.

item.title: Tarcísio anuncia R$ 455 mi para o agro paulista
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas announced a R$ 455 million package for São Paulo's agribusiness at Agrishow 2026, allocating R$ 400 million to rural credit, insurance subsidies, and land regularization, and R$ 55 million to machinery and equipment delivery. The Feap Mulher line will receive R$ 25 million to support female farmers, and R$ 100 million will subsidize rural insurance, covering up to R$ 18 billion in agricultural production value. Since 2023, the state has invested R$ 240 million in farm mechanization.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia lamenta agressividade no debate político: “Horrores”
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cármen Lúcia lamented the deterioration of political dialogue and the rise of personal attacks among lawmakers during the election year, stating that language—meant for debate and persuasion—has been weaponized as aggression.

item.title: Com receio de atos vazios no 1º de Maio, Lula aposta em pronunciamento com medidas contra endividamento
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is expected to avoid attending May Day events to prevent the risk of low-turnout acts that could have negative political repercussions in an election year. Instead, he will deliver a televised and radio address announcing a package of measures to combat household debt, including debt renegotiation with interest capped at 1.99% per month and discounts of up to 90%.

item.title: Crusoé: O manual do eleitor sem dono
item.description: The Brazilian voter without party affiliation or fixed ideology is portrayed as pragmatic, floating, and dissatisfied, casting votes based on concrete issues like gas prices and security, rather than partisan loyalties or idealized political figures.

item.title: Governo deve aportar de R$ 8 bi a R$ 9 bi em fundo para garantia de 'novo Desenrola' e liberar até R$ 7 bi do FGTS
item.description: The Lula government plans to contribute between R$8 billion and R$9 billion to the Credit Guarantee Fund (FGO) to back a new debt renegotiation program similar to 'Desenrola'. It also aims to release between R$4 billion and R$7 billion from the FGTS to allow eligible individuals to pay off bank debts.

item.title: Relator no Conselho de Ética vota para suspender por dois meses mandato de deputados que ocuparam Mesa Diretora
item.description: Moses Rodrigues (União Brasil-CE), the rapporteur in the Chamber's Ethics Council, voted to suspend the mandates of deputies Zé Trovão (PL-SC), Marcos Pollon (PL-MS) and Marcel Van Hattem (Novo-RS) for two months over their role in blocking the Mesa Diretora during an August 6, 2025 protest. The sanction aims to make clear that Parliament will not tolerate actions disrupting legislative functions. A final vote on the report is scheduled for May 5.

item.title: Moraes diz que políticos usam STF como 'escada eleitoral', e Dino defende atuação contra críticas
item.description: Supreme Court Justices Alexandre de Moraes and Flávio Dino stated that politicians are using the STF as an 'electoral stepping stone' by attacking the court to gain votes. They defended the court's independence during Tuesday's hearing, arguing that political criticism of the STF is driven by electoral interests rather than legitimate concerns about justice.

item.title: TSE retoma julgamento que pode cassar governador de RR e deixar ex-mandatário Denarium inelegível
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is resuming judgment that could remove Roraima Governor Edilson Damião (União) from office and declare former Governor Antonio Denarium (Republicanos) ineligible for eight years over alleged abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 campaign. The current vote stands at 2-1 in favor of removing Damião and 3-0 for Denarium’s ineligibility, with three ministers yet to vote. If Damião is removed, Assembly Speaker Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos) would serve as interim governor, followed by an indirect election by state deputies to fill the remainder of the term.

item.title: Acordo entre Mercosul e União Europeia é oficializado e passa a valer em 1º de maio
item.description: President Lula signed the decree promulgating the trade agreement between Mercosul and the European Union, completing Brazil’s internal ratification process. The agreement will provisionally take effect on May 1, following 27 years of negotiations, and covers around 720 million people and economies totaling over US$20 trillion. Lula framed the deal as an assertion of sovereignty and multilateralism, emphasizing that Brazil is no longer a 'banana republic' and that the agreement was forged 'with iron, sweat and blood'.

item.title: STF torna deputado Gustavo Gayer réu por postagem associando Lula ao nazismo e ao Hamas
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court unanimously made federal deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) a defendant, accepting the PGR's indictment over a social media post associating Lula with Nazism and Hamas via a manipulated image. The court ruled the publication exceeded the limits of free speech and political criticism, constituting an attack on the president's honor, and that parliamentary immunity does not apply as the act occurred outside Congress.

item.title: Caiado: Se chegar à Presidência, vou parar essa reforma tributária na hora
item.description: Former Governor of Goiás Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), a pre-candidate for President, stated that if elected, he would immediately halt the ongoing tax reform, despite its transitional phase set to conclude in 2033. He opposed the proposed changes, advocating for a pause in implementation.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja até quando fazer e regularizar título de eleitor
item.description: The deadline to issue or update the voter ID for the 2026 elections is Tuesday, May 6. After this date, the electoral registry will close, and no further regularization, address changes, data updates, or first-time issuance will be possible. The process can be completed online via the TSE's Electronic Self-Service or in person at electoral offices and service centers.

item.title: “Não coloquei nome”, diz homem abordado pela PF por faixa com “ladrão”
item.description: A resident of Presidente Prudente (SP) was approached by the Federal Police after displaying a banner reading 'thief' on his apartment window near an event expected to feature President Lula. The PF stated the act could constitute a crime against honor, though the resident claimed it was generic opinion and made on private property without naming anyone. Lula did not attend the event due to recovery from skin cancer surgery.

item.title: Lula assina decreto que promulga acordo Mercosul–UE e conclui ratificação brasileira do tratado após 27 anos de negociações
item.description: President Lula signed the decree promulgating the Mercosul–EU trade agreement, completing Brazil’s ratification after 27 years of negotiations. The treaty establishes one of the world’s largest free-trade zones, with potential to boost Brazil’s GDP by 0.34% by 2044 and increase exports by 2.65%. Safeguard measures were included to protect industry and agribusiness from sudden import surges.

item.title: Os recados de Motta com a composição da comissão especial da PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta appointed Alencar Santana (PT) to chair the special committee analyzing the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale and Leo Prates (Republicanos) as rapporteur, signaling a balance between the government and the productive sector. The move shows support for the Lula administration by giving the PT control of the committee, while Prates’ appointment aims to satisfy market and business demands for a moderate opinion. The committee is expected to be installed this Wednesday, with a vote in the plenary still possible in May.

item.title: Saiba quem entrou e saiu da CCJ para ajudar indicação de Messias
item.description: The nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court gained momentum in the Senate’s CCJ after two government-aligned senators joined, raising favorable votes from 13 to 15. The opposition also strengthened its presence with the entry of Plínio Valério (PSDB-AM), who will vote against, keeping the total opposed at 8. Three senators remain undeclared, while Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG) is expected to support the nomination.

item.title: Moraes critica políticos que usam ofensas ao STF como ‘escada eleitoral’
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes criticized politicians who use insults against the Supreme Federal Court as a strategy to gain electoral visibility, calling it an 'electoral ladder' and stating these attacks are staged performances aimed solely at personal projection. He noted that legislators have instrumentalized reciprocal insults on social media to generate engagement, without any real offense being felt, and that using the Judiciary for this purpose disrespects the electorate. The criminal complaint between deputies Gustavo Gayer and José Nelto was dismissed by a tie, reinforcing the view that the case was a 'show'.

item.title: 1ª Turma do STF torna Gayer réu por injúria contra Lula
item.description: The 1st Chamber of the Brazilian Supreme Federal Court (STF) made federal deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) a defendant in a criminal case for slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, after he shared an AI-generated montage linking Lula to Hamas and Nazism. The ruling was unanimous, with Justice Flávio Dino as rapporteur, who emphasized that parliamentary immunity does not shield the use of AI to spread defamatory content. Gayer did not appear with legal representation during the session and did not respond to press requests for comment.

item.title: Aldo Rebelo diz que nacionalismo é capaz de unir o Brasil
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Aldo Rebelo (DC) stated that nationalism can unite Brazil, criticizing political, racial, and gender divisions as false. He emphasized his experience in ministerial roles and as PT government leader in Congress, saying he dialogues with all political forces to build a broadly unifying project.

item.title: “Expectativa é que Messias não passe”, diz Damares
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) announced she will vote against Jorge Messias' STF nomination, citing his stance on abortion as a public health issue as a source of resistance, despite Messias being an evangelical. She said she does not believe he will be approved and will not ask questions during the hearing. According to Poder360, Messias has 15 votes in favor and 8 against in the CCJ — one above the minimum needed to advance to the full Senate floor.

item.title: Tarcísio de Freitas diz a Zema que se diverte com caricaturas na política, após atrito do mineiro com Gilmar
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas said he enjoys political caricatures, responding to Romeu Zema's question about whether he had 'retaliated' against satirical depictions of himself. Zema stated he is becoming 'more daring' and accused STF ministers of wanting politicians to act like 'their puppets', following his inclusion in the fake news inquiry over puppet videos criticizing the Court. The exchange took place at Agrishow, amid Zema's escalating criticism of the STF, which he labels as responsible for 'conflicts' and plagued by 'rotten fruits'.

item.title: STF torna Gustavo Gayer réu por injúria contra Lula
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) has opened a criminal action against federal deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) for insulting President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, following a photomontage he posted on X (formerly Twitter) in February 2024. The decision was made by the First Chamber of the STF on Tuesday, the 28th. The case involves allegations of offense to the president’s honor, constituting the crime of slander.

item.title: STF recebe denúncia de comandante do Exército contra Silas Malafaia por injúria
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) received a complaint from the Army Commander against pastor Silas Malafaia for slander, after he called generals 'cowards' and 'weaklings' at a Bolsonarist event in April 2025. The First Chamber partially accepted the complaint, recognizing only the crime of slander due to a tie in voting that favors the defendant. Malafaia will now face charges for slander, with possible compensation, and the case proceeds to the evidentiary phase.

item.title: Governo suspende 3,5 milhões de multas por não pagar pedágio
item.description: The federal government has suspended 3.51 million fines for unpaid electronic tolls (free flow) for 200 days, allowing drivers until November 16 to pay outstanding fees and recover up to five points on their driver's license. The measure addresses widespread lack of user awareness about the toll system and prohibits new fines during the period, while toll operators have 100 days to upgrade systems, integrate data with the National Transit System, and improve signage.

item.title: 1ª Turma do STF torna Gustavo Gayer réu por relacionar Lula a grupos terroristas
item.description: The First Chamber of the Brazilian Supreme Federal Court (STF) unanimously made federal deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) a defendant for the crime of slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, following a February 21, 2024, post on X that combined Lula's face with Nazi symbols and terrorist imagery. The Prosecutor General's Office (PGR) argued the post exceeded parliamentary immunity as it was offensive and disseminated outside Congress. Rapporteur Justice Flávio Dino emphasized it was a manipulative distortion of reality, not legitimate political criticism.

item.title: Moro antecipa voto contrário à indicação de Messias e critica 'momento da escolha'
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) announced his opposition to the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), stating the timing is inappropriate due to the proximity of the 2026 general elections. He criticized what he sees as STF interference in legislative matters and advocated for reforms, including fixed terms for justices, arguing that current long tenures lack institutional accountability. Moro also mentioned his removal as titular of the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ), blaming political maneuvering, and confirmed he will participate in Messias’ hearing as a substitute.

item.title: O que está por trás da troca de afagos entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Tarcísio
item.description: The public exchange of praise between Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio de Freitas at Agrishow aims to project unity on the right, but it masks internal tensions, as Flávio’s candidacy was imposed by the Bolsonaro family despite his own admission that Tarcísio is better prepared. The Bolsonaro clan resists the rise of independent leaders, and Flávio lacks his father’s authority, undermining his ability to present a stable, moderate candidacy.

item.title: Com empate, STF recebe denúncia contra Malafaia de forma parcial
item.description: The First Chamber of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) ruled to make Pastor Silas Malafaia a defendant for injury following a tied vote, rejecting the accusation of slander. Relator Alexandre de Moraes and Minister Flávio Dino voted to accept the full prosecution complaint, while Cristiano Zanin and Cármen Lúcia advocated only for the injury charge. The ruling distinguishes between slander (imputing a specific crime) and injury (offense to dignity).

item.title: PL aciona TSE contra Lula por possível abuso em pronunciamento do Dia da Mulher
item.description: The PL party filed a representation with the TSE accusing President Lula of abuse of political power during his official International Women's Day speech, claiming it was used for premature electoral propaganda. The complaint highlights mentions of government programs like Farmácia Popular, Pé-de-Meia, and IR exemption for earners up to R$5,000 as evidence of illicit partisan messaging. Lawyers are seeking the maximum fine and an urgent injunction before Workers' Day on May 1st.

item.title: Lula assina nomeação de Odair Cunha ao TCU
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed the appointment of Deputy Odair Cunha (PT-MG) as a minister of the Tribunal de Contas da União (TCU), filling the vacancy left by the retirement of Minister Aroldo Cedraz. Odair, serving his sixth consecutive term as a federal deputy, was approved by the Chamber with 303 votes and by the Senate with 50 favorable votes, becoming the first PT-affiliated congressman to join the court. The appointment follows the TCU’s rule that vacancies must be filled by the same institution that nominated the previous minister.

item.title: Crusoé: 68% ainda não sabem quem governa Minas, aponta Quaest
item.description: A Genial/Quaest poll shows that 68% of Minas Gerais residents do not know who the current governor, Mateus Simões (PSD), is. Simões took office in March 2026 after Romeu Zema (Novo) left to run for president. The survey highlights low public awareness and recognition of the governor across the state.

item.title: Deputado bolsonarista virá réu por injúria após fazer montagem de Lula segurando fuzil
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) opened a criminal complaint against bolsonarist deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) for defamation against President Lula, after he posted a false montage of the president holding a rifle with Nazi symbols. The First Chamber ruled that the political criticism crossed the line of tolerance and lifted parliamentary immunity. Rapporteur Minister Flávio Dino emphasized the gravity of image forgery in an era of dangerous digital manipulations.

item.title: A indireta de Moraes a Zema durante julgamento no STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes indirectly criticized Romeu Zema, stating that politicians lacking sufficient votes use attacks on the Judiciary as an 'electoral ladder' instead of discussing public policies. Zema has intensified his criticism of the STF, including through humorous videos on social media, prompting Justice Gilmar Mendes to request his inclusion in the fake news inquiry.

item.title: STF torna Gustavo Gayer réu sob acusação de injúria por ligar Lula a Hamas e nazismo
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court has made bolsonarist deputy Gustavo Gayer a defendant in an insult case after he linked President Lula to Hamas and Nazism. The decision by the First Chamber was unanimous, paving the way for criminal proceedings. The case reflects heightened political tensions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Motta anuncia presidente e relator do fim da escala 6×1 na comissão especial
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta announced that Deputy Alencar Santana (PT-SP) will preside and Deputy Leo Prates (Republicanos-BA) will rapporteur the special committee analyzing the end of the 6×1 work schedule. The committee, with 37 titular and 37 alternate members, must conclude its work by the end of May, aiming to approve a proposal reducing the weekly workweek from 44 to 36 hours, amid two PECs and a government bill for 40 hours with two rest days.

item.title: Base do governo na Alesp turbina homenagens a lideranças políticas neste mandato
item.description: The São Paulo State Legislative Assembly (Alesp) has significantly increased the awarding of the Legislative Merit Honor Collar during the current term under President André do Prado (PL), with 108 sessions held since 2023 — a 66% increase over the previous eight years combined. Recipients include Gilberto Kassab (PSD), Ricardo Nunes (MDB), Carlos Bolsonaro (PL), and Renata Abreu (Podemos), highlighting the influence of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’s base in the honors process.

item.title: Moraes repudia “agressões verbais” ao STF como “escada eleitoral”
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes condemned verbal attacks by politicians against the Judiciary, calling them an 'electoral ladder' used to target candidates lacking sufficient votes. He stated there is a deliberate effort to exploit a supposed polarization against the Court through verbal aggression to influence the electoral process.

item.title: STF torna Malafaia réu por injúria e rejeita calúnia
item.description: The STF ruled to make pastor Silas Malafaia a defendant for insulting Army generals, rejecting the slander charge as the criticisms were deemed generic and not aimed at specific individuals. A tie on the slander issue favored the defendant under the CPP, while the majority found sufficient evidence for insult. The case will proceed to the evidentiary phase.

item.title: PL aciona TSE para impedir Lula de promover governo e atacar adversários em pronunciamento
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) filed a request with the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) to restrict President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s national radio and TV address on Workers’ Day, arguing he might use the platform to promote his government and attack political opponents. The petition seeks to prevent Lula from making partisan or campaign-like statements during the free electoral broadcast. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: STF torna Gayer réu por publicação que compara Lula a terroristas
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) unanimously decided to make federal deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) a defendant for posting a social media montage comparing President Lula to terrorists, including Nazi swastikas and symbols. The Prosecutor General's Office argued the post exceeds parliamentary immunity, constituting defamation and image manipulation. The case will now proceed to the evidentiary phase, with witness testimony and the defendant's interrogation, ahead of a final verdict on guilt or acquittal.

item.title: De 'Bessias' da Lava Jato a evangélico indicado ao STF: a trajetória de Jorge Messias
item.description: Jorge Messias, Attorney General of the Union and Lula's nominee to the STF, will undergo a Senate CCJ hearing on April 29, 2026, to fill the vacancy left by Luís Roberto Barroso. Holding a law degree and master's and doctorate in International Development and Cooperation from UnB, Messias has been a federal prosecutor since 2007 and held legal advisory roles in PT administrations, including as Subchief for Legal Affairs of the Presidency. He criticized Dilma Rousseff's impeachment as a 'painful defeat' in his 2024 doctoral thesis.

item.title: STF rejeita queixa de Gustavo Gayer contra José Nelto
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) rejected a criminal complaint filed by federal deputy Gustavo Gayer against José Nelto for defamation and insult, with a dissenting vote by Alexandre de Moraes and Cristiano Zanin, who argued the mutual offenses were instrumentalized for electoral self-promotion. Relator Cármen Lúcia and Flávio Dino voted to accept the complaint, but the tie favored the accused, José Nelto, under the principle of in dubio pro reu. The incident followed Nelto’s March 2023 remarks calling Gayer a 'Nazi' and 'fascist'.
